Limit: whether the Telex social accounts should be renamed or replaced is a team decision; the task escalates it rather than guessing.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: One external-link register, owner-confirmed replacements and a repeatable recheck
acceptedWorkstreams.description:
Evidence checked 22 Oct 2026: /, /pricing, /download and /resources each expose the same six external destinations: the two app stores, Facebook and three Telex-named social accounts. That is a sample, not a full-site audit or proof any destination is broken. The existing Telex task cmvje2gn703x0122m83md6z6f already owns those brand references; reuse its evidence and decisions rather than commission that audit again. The internal-link map covers a different graph.

Approach: crawl the current public marketing route inventory and build one deduplicated external-destination register, retaining every referring page, anchor/control, source file and link purpose. Check final destination, redirect chain, response and actual page/app identity. Distinguish a genuine missing/wrong destination from a login wall, blocked automated check, region restriction or timeout; use a normal GET when HEAD is unsupported and mark unverified results instead of calling them broken. Exclude private app routes and non-HTTP actions from the web-status check.

For each real defect, propose the exact replacement and evidence of intended ownership. Unknown social accounts, press claims and store identities require a named team decision; never guess an account or redirect all failures to the homepage. Fix only approved destinations in the actual shared source, preserving appropriate link text. Cross-reference existing Telex, download/QR and resource-route tasks and avoid duplicate patches.

One cohesive SEO task delivers the source/destination register, approved fix patch, decision list and repeatable check with before/after evidence; a team member deploys it and supplies the live recheck. Success is correct, usable destinations with unresolved ownership visible, not a fabricated all-green status report.
